_comment: The battle debug simulator (combat rework S9b): tools/battle_debug/, ui/dev/battle_debugger/. Dev builds only (the editor, or an export with the battle_debugger feature tag).
_simulate_comment: Simulate: fights per policy, and the policies compared (FightScenario names), on seeds from the fight's own seed up. draw_enemies false fields the fight's current enemies (as edited) every seed; true draws them from the enemy table per seed (TODO(decision: debugger-sim-enemies)).
_files_comment: Where Save to data writes each kind of change, and where Export tuning diff puts its files.
_snapshots_comment: Rewind keeps one snapshot per decision, up to max_snapshots (the oldest go first).
_ui_comment: The debugger panel: its width, and how many change-log lines and timeline entries it lists. While it is open the window's view is widened by panel_width (drawn a little smaller), so the battle screen keeps its full width beside it.
